DOC_A.title: Sequence Modeling with Recurrent Encoders (synthetic fixture A)

chunks.text: We train all models using the Adam optimizer with a learning rate of 0.0003 and a batch size of 64. Training runs for 12 epochs on a single GPU. We use a dropout rate of 0.1 applied to the output of each sub-layer.
Our encoder consists of 6 stacked recurrent layers with a hidden dimension of 512. We evaluate on the WMT 2014 English-to-German task and report a BLEU score of 27.3 on the newstest2014 test set.

All models are optimized using SGD with Nesterov momentum, a learning rate of 0.25 and a batch size of 128. Training proceeds for 40 epochs across 8 GPUs. We apply a dropout rate of 0.2 throughout the network.
The convolutional encoder uses 15 layers with a hidden dimension of 768. Evaluated on the IWSLT 2015 English-to-Vietnamese task, our system attains a BLEU score of 31.9 on the official test split.
